title: Simple Copy-Paste is a Strong Data Augmentation Method for Instance Segmentation
mechanism: Paste object instances at random onto other images; this is a strong augmentation for instance segmentation.
evidence: Gains at every COCO data fraction; a widely used baseline (1,464 citations per the index).
adaptation: Use only as the benchmark's plain copy-paste baseline, reporting the decoy test alongside it.
min_experiment: Plain random crack copy-paste vs house model, 5 seeds, with the decoy rate reported. Benchmark row only, no kill line.
prior_overlap: Closed for scores: CP100 tested a stricter version (residual transfer) at 100% labels, n.d., with a decoy FLAG.

alt_notes.adaptation: Already tested in our variant (CP100); include only as the benchmark's plain copy-paste baseline with the decoy test reported.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark run with decoy rate; no kill.
